The Home

Classic character, modern comfort

Welcome to a beautifully maintained Cape Cod offering roughly 2,300 square feet of comfortable living space on just over an acre in the Town of Marcy. Spacious living areas and generous bedrooms give you plenty of room for everyday life and for entertaining.

The finished walkout basement expands the home with a large family room complete with a bar, a dedicated home gym, and a private wine cellar — perfect for hosting or for quiet evenings in. Step outside to a backyard retreat with an above-ground pool, an expansive yard, and space for recreation and gardening.

The acre-plus lot delivers a rare blend of privacy and convenience, just minutes from shopping, restaurants, parks, and major commuter routes.
